I'll be brief. It's only me, but have 20+ yr tech experience. Due to lost work/clients focused on ActorDo.

It connects Email, Calendar, Tasks over Microsoft and Gmail accounts.

It's an agentic AI that you can ask or make requests over the tools. Also created Slack, Microsoft Teams, Whatsapp, Outlook Add-in, Chrome extension

It also has an Automations Studio for trackable automations. Built-in editable memory for all interactions.

It really saves users time. How do I sell it?
